blind_audit.rationale: KCNQ2 encodes Kv7.2, which commonly coassembles with Kv7.3 to generate the neuronal M-current. This low-threshold, slowly activating outward potassium current stabilizes membrane excitability; loss of current increases the tendency to repetitive firing and seizures. Strongest alternative resolved: Increasing HCN-mediated inward current can increase excitability in other settings, but it is not the current encoded by KCNQ2. The stem directly supplies KCNQ2 loss of function and reduced outward current near rest, which specifically identifies loss of the Kv7.2/Kv7.3 M-current.
